authority_note: Host roles are declared here and enforced by roles/role-guard.mjs (fail-closed). Role names follow the owner's architectural intent (dial-hermes-control, vekl-worker, oracle-admin). The unmerged Oracle lineage (PR #24/#26/#27) names the background node 'oracle-admin-v2'; canonical master names no second node at all. Mapping vekl-worker <-> oracle-admin-v2 is OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED and is recorded in the audit, not silently resolved here. The unmerged branch work/bootstrap-reconcile-20260914 (2026-09-14) uses the same three node names with classes CONTROL_AUTHORITY / BACKGROUND_COORDINATOR / RECOVERY_CONTROL_ONLY and a key=value /etc/dial/host-role; this guard reads that file format too so the two converge on one role declaration.
resolution_order: hostname exact match against role aliases
otherwise UNKNOWN -> every governed workload is refused

dial-hermes-control.description: Primary DIAL development orchestration/control plane: owner intake, Hermes runtime, mission control, VEKL orchestration, external queue, operator gateway. Carries eligible heavy compute only when provider-side execution is not possible.

vekl-worker.description: Second worker VM for background/worker-class development activity that must not burden the control plane: VEKL research refresh, structural snapshot extraction, indexing, document processing, deterministic verification replicas. Never a control authority, never a Hermes manager runtime, never an owner-control endpoint. Heavy compute (full verification, builds) is rejected: it belongs to provider-side execution or, when host-bound, to dial-hermes-control (the unmerged execution-fabric lineage names this class BACKGROUND_COORDINATOR).

oracle-admin.description: Infrastructure administration, recovery, emergency access, Desktop Commander remote recovery, infrastructure health, break-glass. Must never become a normal development worker.

provider-container.description: Claude Code Remote / Codex cloud execution container. Ephemeral; carries bounded repository development on a topic branch, read-only repository context, evidence generation and PR workflow. It has no control home, no systemd, no Hermes runtime and no owner-control authority.

workloads.OWNER_CONTROL: typed dial_* owner controls, steering broker, WhatsApp adapters
workloads.HERMES_RUNTIME: Hermes manager runtime (Codex App Server / Claude Code exact slots)
workloads.VEKL_RESOLVE: engineering-knowledge resolution / activation for a packet
workloads.VEKL_RESEARCH: ahead-of-work presearch refresh (network to allowlisted sources)
workloads.STRUCTURAL_SNAPSHOT: structural code-graph extraction (TypeScript baseline; Graphify only when qualified)
workloads.OPERATOR_GATEWAY: chat-control HTTP MCP, operator stdio MCP
workloads.DETERMINISTIC_VERIFY: npm run verify and its sub-gates
workloads.REPOSITORY_WRITE: editing and committing the DIAL repository
workloads.WORKER_DISPATCH: dispatching a bounded job to a worker host over SSH
workloads.WORKER_JOB: executing an allowlisted worker job and returning a receipt
workloads.DIAGNOSTICS: read-only host, service and repository inspection
workloads.OCI_RECOVERY: cloud console / OCI CLI recovery actions
workloads.BREAK_GLASS: emergency access and repair of other hosts
workloads.SSH_BROKER: brokering SSH into other estate hosts
